mood_contract: Unleashed leverage: the student sees the loop improve work while they own the yardstick and the boundary. Never eval-as-compliance.

intended_learnings.text: The judge stays fixed and separate from the generator; that is why the score means anything.
Groundedness protects the floor; steering against a fixed judge raises the ceiling.
A flat score is information about the judge or the work. Check both.
You design the loop and own the yardstick; you no longer sit inside every iteration.
